$comment: MCP tool contract for the PROD-only `publish` server (AB#645219). Schema is the TARGET contract. Current handler (Invoke-PublishTool.ps1) is a behavior-preserving per-phase pass-through: it sets REVIEW_PHASE=post and delegates to Invoke-CopilotPRReview.ps1 (generate output via REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR, PR context via env). This is an ADDITIVE, opt-in capability - review.yml still calls the script directly, so existing pipelines are untouched; consumers migrate one at a time. This JSON I/O is honored once the post logic physically moves into the tool. BC-Bench never loads this server, so eval physically cannot post - no mode flag required.
name: publish
description: Post review findings as inline PR comments. Suggestion placement (re-derive the RIGHT-side span), location dedup vs existing comments, iteration numbering, comment rendering, POST, and (future) reaction backfill. Consumes the raw findings[] emitted by the review tool.

findings.description: The raw findings[] from review - a stateless, tokenless handoff.

iteration_ctx.description: Reserved for cross-iteration memory (feed prior comments + reactions back in). Opaque for now.

skipped.description: Findings not posted, each with a reason (location dedup, unsafe suggestion placement, cap, etc.).
